messages:
Priya: quick heads-up, i posted an RFC for the /v1/generate launch SLOs and gate criteria. need sign-off on ACs before canary next thursday. https://redwood-internal/docs/rfcs/gen-slo-launch

Ethan: perf snapshot from prod-stable (4xA100, typical <=128 tokens): P50 34ms, P95 208ms, 5xx+timeouts ~0.3%. numbers stable over 72h window.

Samar: thanks. my proposal to be conservative for initial rollout: P50 <=50ms, P95 <=250ms, availability >=99.5% (monthly error budget 0.5%). separate SLO group for long-context runs (>1k).

Clara: UX note: if we switch to degraded model we must show developer-facing banner: "Reduced-quality mode — faster responses" with tooltip explaining why and how to opt out. no silent quality changes.

Priya: agree. adding runtime graceful-degrade rules is required. draft acceptance criteria below.

Ethan: runtime fallback policy sketch i can ship behind feature-flag:
```
policy:
  route: /v1/generate
  p95_threshold_ms: 240
  on_exceed:
    fallback_to: model-small-quant
  max_inflight_for_fallback: 200
  cooldown_seconds: 60
```

Samar: +1. also log span tag slo.fallback=true and emit metric `redwood.generate.fallback.count`. SRE will need that for burn-rate analysis.

Priya: Acceptance criteria (launch gate) — can we confirm by Wed EOD?
- Eng: runtime fallback + feature flag `slo_fallback_v1` + unit/integration tests.
- SRE: dashboards for P50/P95/5xx, fallback count metric, error-budget burn alert that pages if sustained >3x for 30m.
- UX: banner + tooltip copy and docs entry.
- Product: rollout plan, rollback criteria in the RFC.

Ethan: i can do the runtime changes. estimate 2 dev days + 1 test day. will standardize metric names: `redwood.generate.latency.p50_ms`, `redwood.generate.latency.p95_ms`, `redwood.generate.errors.count`, `redwood.generate.fallback.count`.

Samar: SRE will build dashboards. tiny ask: keep per-route metrics high-res for 7d and 90d aggregated retention. add that to ACs please.

Priya: added. edge cases to call out in RFC replies: hotspot tenant with huge seqs -> tenant-level throttle; cross-region fallback must be opt-in (do not auto-cross region); client retry guidance (idempotent retries, `Retry-After`, jitter).

Clara: banner copy suggestion: "We're temporarily serving a faster, lower-cost variant of the model to keep responses quick. Switch back in Settings if you need full quality." plus link to docs.

Samar: also include a playbook step for investigating fallback spikes: correlate fallback.count with model context length and tenant id, check KV cache hit rate.

Priya: SLA stance: propose beta SLA 99.5% for generate with credits only for sustained monthly breaches. conservative until metrics and rollouts are stable.

Ethan: ok by me.

Priya: next steps: Ethan opens PR with `slo_fallback_v1` flag + code; Samar drafts dashboard + runbook; Clara wires copy into docs; i'll update RFC with final ACs and rollout timeline. target canary next thursday. :thumbsup:

slo-bot: reminder — tag RFC with `slo:required` and `feature:canary` for tracking.

Priya: thanks all. ping me on PR if anything blocks.
